fact: Acta Eruditorum, September 1694 issue: Bernoulli describes the lemniscate (a 4th-degree curve) and shows elastica arcs are built by rectifying lemniscate and ellipse, since integrals of type z^2dz over sqrt(a^4-z^4) reduce to them.

note: Read the OCR of the 1694 volume; the September issue passage names the lemniscate and the elastica link, so Bernoulli did relate the integral to lemniscate and ellipse arcs; the arcsine analogy was not seen.
